Whole blood sample of the HIV-positive pregnant woman will be drawn on a fixed day in the week in consultation with the nearest ART centre and collected in EDTA vacuum tube and sent to the nearest ART centre in a cold box through a messenger. It has to be ensured that the sample reaches the nearest ART centre within 24 hours of drawing of the sample.
